# ShaleIT tools

> Free, open-source tools from ShaleIT that run entirely in the browser. Nothing you type or upload is sent anywhere, and no sign-up is needed. Licensed under the MIT License.

## Tools

- [QR code maker](https://shaleit.tech/qr): Make a QR code for a web address, Wi-Fi network, phone number or text, and download it as PNG or SVG.
- [Password maker](https://shaleit.tech/password): Make a strong random password or an easy-to-remember passphrase.
- [Image shrinker](https://shaleit.tech/image): Resize and compress photos for websites or email, and remove hidden location details.
- [Contrast checker](https://shaleit.tech/contrast): Check text and background colours against WCAG 2.2 contrast ratios, with a one-click fix.
- [PDF merger](https://shaleit.tech/pdf): Join several PDFs into one in the order you choose, or pull out just some pages.
- [Unit converter](https://shaleit.tech/units): Convert length, weight, temperature, cooking volume and more. Fractions and 5'11" are accepted.
- [Favicon maker](https://shaleit.tech/favicon): Make a favicon pack (ICO, PNGs, web manifest) from a letter or an image.

## Self-hosted

- [Lab Docs](https://github.com/shandraco/lab-docs): Fill in contracts (MSA, statement of work), outreach emails and capability statements from templates, and download PDF or Word. A Next.js and PostgreSQL app you run on your own server, with sign-in for your team. MIT License.

## Developer tools

- [Cockpit for Claude Code](https://github.com/shandraco/shaleit-agent-kit/tree/main/cockpit): A Claude Code mod that shows context and cost above the prompt, lists running subagents, and asks before wide or destructive commands. MIT.
- [Safety hooks for Claude Code](https://github.com/shandraco/shaleit-agent-kit/tree/main/hooks): Hook scripts that block secrets in a notes folder, warn on large context, and guard Vercel deploys. MIT.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/shandraco/shaleit-tools): The code for every browser tool.
- [Agent kit repository](https://github.com/shandraco/shaleit-agent-kit): Cockpit and the hooks.
- [MIT License](https://shaleit.tech/LICENSE.txt): Free to use, copy and change.
